dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_a_z_01.on_: So the rift chose well. Remember this fight.
Strength is not enough. Learn what it protects.
Go on. The road ahead needs you.
I have waited a very long time for someone to stand where you stand.
Show me what you carry through the rift, traveler.
Do not hold back. I will not.
Not yet. You are not ready to bear what is coming.
Rest, traveler. Then come back stronger.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_a_z_02.on_: At last. Someone who can bear what I could not.
Go. The world has need of you more than I do.
We meet again. This time I will hold nothing back.
Long have I carried my sorrow. Let it be settled here.
Show me what the rift has made of you.
Even now, it is not enough. I am sorry, traveler.
The wait goes on. Go and heal.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_brann_01.o: Hmph. Your bond is real. I will admit that.
I yield. This duel was fought with honor.
Go on. But I will be watching you.
No Outsider crosses this ground without proving worth.
I guard this border. Raise your Pokemon.
Pertinax asked for strength. I will give him some.
You are not ready for what lies past here.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_captain_ar: Haha! Now that is power! You earned that win!
My muscles are sore and my heart is happy. Well done!
You are strong, no question. I am proud to have fought you.
Stand tall! Power solves everything, so show me yours!
My partner and I have faced hundreds of fights. Bring it on!
Come on, no holding back. Strength is honest!
Ha! That is the power of a true bond! Train harder!
Good effort! Keep growing and come back stronger.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_captain_pe: Well I'll be. You reeled me in fair and square.
Good battle, friend. Strong current in you.
Mind the water out there. It remembers everything.
Easy now, stranger. The fish are slow today, but my team is not.
Cast your line, newcomer. Let us see what you pull in.
Twenty years of waiting on tides. I have patience to spare.
Ha! The old tide still beats a fresh wave, friend.
Do not fret. Even good fishers lose a few lines.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_crystal_is: Marvelous. You are a treasure I did not expect to find.
I have never held a prize quite like this victory of yours.
Go with my respect. You have earned it.
Welcome to my collection. Today you are the rarest piece in it.
I love beautiful things. I hope your strength is one of them.
The sun is bright and the wind is with me. Shall we begin?
A fine fight, but my collection is safe for now.
Do not be disheartened. Rare things take time to shine.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_daro_01.on: A fair duel. The shrine is open to you.
You fought with respect. That is rare.
The shrine is sacred. You will face me first.
Ekayon trusts few. I trust his judgment, and my claws.
Fight well, Outsider. The shrine is watching.
The shrine is not for you. Not yet.
Rest, and return with a clearer mind.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_dax_moreau: Hm. You have power. I will admit it, just this once.
A fair loss. Do not think I will let it happen again.
Remember my name. We will fight again.
So you are the Outsider. Show me whether you are worth my time.
I only duel those who can fight. Prove you can.
Do not disappoint me. Strength deserves a real opponent.
Not yet strong enough. Come back when you have trained.
I respect the effort. But effort is not enough.
Impressive. You have earned my attention.
I lost, and I will not pretend otherwise. Well fought.
Next time I will not lose.
You again. Good. I wanted to see if you had grown.
Since our last duel I trained harder. Do you see the gap?
Show me strength worth respecting.
You are improving, but I am still ahead.
Keep climbing. I will be waiting at the top.
Hah. You beat me fair and square. I respect that.
Strength like yours is worth chasing. I will catch you.
Good duel. Truly.
Strong opponents are rare here. You are one of them.
I fight with pride and I expect the same from you.
Let us see which of us is stronger today.
Pride must be backed by power. Today mine was.
You fought well. Do not stop now.
Good. That is the strength this world needs.
I have nothing left to teach you in a duel.
Go on. I will keep up, do not worry.
The danger is real now. I need to know you can handle it.
I am not here to hold you back. I am here to test you.
Fight like it matters, because it does.
Not yet. A stronger fighter is needed. Train more.
You are close. Do not waste what you have.
You have surpassed me. I say it with respect.
A great fighter beat me today. No shame in that.
One last duel remains. Be ready.
We have come far. I will not lose my pride at this stage.
I want a duel worthy of everything we have done.
Give me everything you have. I will do the same.
My strength held. But you made it close.
I will not call it easy. You are formidable.
You have beaten me, and I could not be prouder to lose.
The strongest stands before me. I bow to that.
Go. And fight with the pride you showed me today.
Final duel. I have trained for this moment, and so have you.
No excuses, no regrets. Only the strongest stays standing.
I respect you, so I will fight with everything.
I won, but you stand as my equal. That is rare.
It was an honor to fight you.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_dr_ingrid_: Excellent! That result changes my calculations.
Good work. Your results go straight in my notes.
Remarkable. Let us train again soon.
Perfect timing. I need live data on your team.
Training match! Do not hold back, I take notes.
The rifts taught me to expect anything. Show me.
Fascinating. Your weak points are now on record.
Review your tactics, then we run it again.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_dr_mordeca: A flawed experiment! I must rerun the numbers.
Lysandre will not like this report.
Interesting. You are more than a variable.
Hold still, specimen. The rifts are my study, and you are a fine variable.
Lord Lysandre needs data, and your Pokemon will provide it.
This is purely scientific. Try not to scream.
Fascinating. Entirely as predicted. Take notes, subject.
Your results are poor. I will file them.
You fight to protect, not to take. I see it.
Good. The world needed to see that.
I will not stand against you. Not today.
I do not hate you. I need to know who you are.
My people are hurt. Show me you can be trusted.
Lucario, Zeraora, Zoroark. We face you as one.
Your resolve is not yet steady. Think on that.
Strength alone fixes nothing. Learn more.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_elder_pax_: Well done. You have a good heart and a steady hand.
Hear me: someone is coming. Be ready.
Peace to you, Outsider. Remember this day.
Ah, an Outsider. Come, let us talk with our Pokemon.
Peace is not weakness, child. Shall we begin?
Slowking and I have time. Do you?
Do not be sad. Every fall teaches something.
Slowly, child. Slowly. Come back when ready.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_flare_digg: Ow, my back! I only wanted the shiny stuff.
Fine, fine, I lost. The hole was not that deep anyway.
Lysandre pays me to dig, not to lose!
Hah! Dug up a visitor instead of treasure. Fine by me!
My shovel is dull but my Pokemon are not.
Boss wants the ground emptied. You are in the way!
Dig deep, kid. You got buried!
Back to the pit with you. Ha!
dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_flare_grun: Ash is all I have left. Ugh!
Hey, that was a fluke! Next time you burn.
Lysandre is going to be so mad at me.
Heh, you picked the wrong day to snoop around.
Team Flare does not lose to nobodies. Get ready!
I will burn you down to ash. Get it? Ash!
Too easy! Flare rules, loser!
Cry about it somewhere else.
Dust?! No, you got lucky!
Tch, I got swept instead. Humiliating.
The boss will hear about this, I swear.
Look what crawled in. Let me throw you out with the trash.
You are a speck of dust to Team Flare!
Step aside or get swept aside.
Swept away, just like I said. Pathetic!
Scram, dust. Flare is busy.
Dulled by a nobody. Ouch.
You were sharper than I thought.
Okay okay, you pass. Do not tell anyone I said that.
Halt! Flare territory. You get a pointy welcome from me.
I am the sharpest grunt in Team Flare. Prove me wrong!
One poke and you will fold, outsider.
Poked and dropped. Sharp as ever!
Come back when you are less soft.
That was not in the script!
I must rewrite my report. This is bad.
Fine, you win this page. The story is not over.
Write this down, I am about to beat you.
Team Flare took notes on you. You lose in the first line.
My Pokemon are ready, and my pen is mightier!
Chapter closed. You lost, as written.
Better luck in your next draft.
No way. I had the boss's attention!
Fine, fine. Just do not tell the Admins.
This was supposed to be easy money.
Flare sent me to clear the path. You are the path.
Step aside, Outsider. Or get stepped on.
Lysandre wants this world, and I want a bonus.
Ha! Told you. Flare does not lose.
Go home, if you can find the rift.
Tch. The Admins will not like this.
You got lucky. Next time I bring friends.
Fine. Take your win and get lost.
Nothing personal. Orders are orders.
Team Flare is everywhere now. You are late.
Show me what an Outsider is worth.
Easy. Flare takes another step forward.
You should have stayed through the rift.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_flare_hack: My Pokemon... but the data is safe with me.
Beaten by a trainer, not a firewall. Humiliating.
Keep it. I copied everything anyway.
Your machine's secrets are already on my screen.
I did not come to fight, but sure, why not.
One battle and I still walk out with the data.
Download complete. Thanks for the distraction.
Too slow. My files are already gone.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_flare_raid: The raid is not over. I only lost a round.
You hit harder than the others did.
Raid time! Hold the line if you can!
We hit hard and fast. Try to keep up!
Weak defense. The raid goes on.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_gus_thornt: Hah! Solid hits. That is how you earn respect.
Good sparring. You fight with an honest heart.
Keep training and you will go far, recruit.
Recruit! Guard up. No mercy in the sparring ring.
Fists and Pokemon, that is how we learn. Come on!
Show me your stance, newcomer. Strength, then honor.
Too soft! Get up, dust off, and train again.
Pain is a teacher. Hit the mat and try once more.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_hector_lin: Impressive! My arms shake, and so does my pride.
You are strong. Go on, the Captain will be glad.
Good fight. I will train harder tomorrow.
Nobody gets past me to the Captain. Nobody.
Flex all you want. I do not budge.
Hup! Let us see how strong you really are.
Not even a sweat. Back to training, friend.
The Captain's guard stands. As always.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_hesk_01.on: Tch. You earned that win, I suppose.
My stance holds, but you fought well.
Pertinax will hear of this. Pass.
Pertinax does not like visitors. Neither do I.
Turn around, Outsider, or lose here.
This border is mine to hold. Let us begin.
Too weak. Go back where you came from.
The Overworld has no room for the careless.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_ilu_01.on_: You are patient and strong. Well done.
I step aside. The shrine accepts you.
Walk softly in there. It is a holy place.
I guard the shrine, Outsider. Do not rush me.
Ekayon asked me to hold this place. I will.
The shrine stays quiet today. Try again later.
You rushed. The Overworld rewards patience.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_ines_carva: Clean execution. I could not fault your form.
Well done. You listened to your own training.
Rest well. Tomorrow we raise the standard.
Line up, recruit. Form first, power second. Begin!
I teach discipline. Let us see how much you kept.
Eyes forward, breathe, and fight with purpose.
Sloppy footwork. Again, and this time focus.
Discipline beats raw effort. Remember that.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_kenji_aoki: Well fought. Your discipline is real.
A clean victory. I respect that.
Keep training. You will go far.
Discipline first, then power. Show me both.
Bow, then fight. That is how we begin.
I train fighters. Let me see if you are one.
Your form is loose. Train, then return.
Strength without discipline is noise. Again.
I bow to you. That was a true fight.
Walk proudly. You earned every step.
No more training. This is the real test.
Years of discipline stand behind every move. Come.
Give me everything you have. I will not hold back.
Not yet. Return when your will is firmer.
A fighter learns from defeat. Learn well.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_king_of_th: The crown wobbles! You have earned my respect, traveler.
The flock is stunned, but proud of you.
Go forth, challenger. The throne will remember you.
Bow before the King of the Wooloo! Fluffy, loyal, and mighty!
My royal flock has never lost a bleating contest!
Approach, traveler, and face the wool of destiny!
The crown stays on my head! Long live the wool!
Fear not, even kings lose to nobody today. Hahaha!
The crown falls! You have bested the King of the Wooloo.
After all this time, you still surprise me.
The flock bows to you. Wear your victory well.
The King returns! The flock has grown mightier, traveler!
I have trained through every storm. This crown is heavier now.
Prepare yourself! This is the royal rematch!
The throne holds! Wool conquers all, once more!
Even after everything, the flock stays unbeaten. Hahaha!
dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_kitu_01.on: You fought with care. I will tell the others.
The way is open. Walk it gently.
I saw something honest in you today.
I watch the Outsiders. Now I watch how you fight.
The border is quiet. Let us see if you are too.
Show me what you carry in your heart, Outsider.
The path stays closed for now. Come back stronger.
You walk loudly. The land hears it.
Your spirit is strong. This defeat honors me.
You carry the will of someone who fights for something.
Walk with pride. We will meet again, I think.
I am Korrak. I do not hate you, Outsider, but I will test you.
A duel of honor is a gift. Give me your full strength.
No tricks, no mercy, no shame. Come.
You fought well, but strength must be earned. Train more.
The duel is mine. Rise and try again, with honor.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_lysandre_0: Impossible. I have planned for everything but you.
This changes nothing. I will find another way.
You may have won today. I do not forget.
You are too late. The world is already forgetting what it lost.
I was sent here last, and I came back with a purpose.
I will not stop. Stand aside, or be removed.
Pathetic. Nothing will stand in the way of my plan.
This is how it ends for those who resist me.
No! Not again! I was so close to fixing everything!
How can you keep standing against me?
This is not over. It cannot be over.
I lost everything once. I will not lose it again!
Everything I did was for a better world. You will not take it!
Enough games. This ends here, and I win!
You see? You could never stop me. Now step aside.
The future is mine, and the world will burn bright.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_marlo_01.o: Okay, okay. You beat me. Do not let it go to your head.
Hm. A lone wolf can respect a good rival.
Next time I will be stronger. Count on it.
Hey you! I take on anyone. Today that is you.
No team, no rules, just a good fight. Ready?
Nobody beat me yet. Let us see if you do.
Ha! Still undefeated on this road. Try again sometime.
Not today, newcomer. The road is mine.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_marlo_02.o: Ugh, you grew too. Fine, you earned it.
Hard times make us stronger, and you proved it.
I will chase you down for a third round.
Back again? I have grown stronger since our last fight.
Things changed around here, but I did not lose my edge.
Round two. No holding back this time.
Still the road's best. You will need more than that.
I trained for this. Did you?
dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_mira_okoye: Whoa, you are good! Okay, I am officially jealous.
Fine, you win this one. But I am going to train twice as hard.
Good fight! Do not get comfortable, I will catch up.
Hey, you are the Outsider from the rift! I am Mira. Battle me?
I am going to find the first relic, and you are not beating me to it!
Friendly match, sure. But I am playing to win!
Ha! One point to me. Do not sulk, you will get better.
That was fun! Next time bring your best, I will.
Okay, you earned that one. You keep surprising me.
Ugh, I was so sure! Fine, you are officially my rival.
I will be back stronger. Count on it.
Look who is back! I have been training since our last match.
No hard feelings, but I am not losing to you twice!
Ready? I have a few new tricks to show off.
Yes! Told you I would improve. Better luck next time!
I won this time, but you made me work for it.
Wow. You are getting scary good, you know that?
Fine, fine, you win. But I am right behind you!
That was a real fight. I needed that.
There you are! I knew we would meet again out here.
I have seen things that changed how I fight. Let me show you.
This is not just a game for me anymore. Go all out!
I did not want to win like this, but I am not holding back.
You are close, I can feel it. Keep pushing!
You are ahead of me. I hate it and I love it.
Okay, now I really have something to prove.
Go. I will meet you at the top, just wait.
Things are getting serious, so I am not going easy on you.
Every time we fight, I learn something. Teach me more!
Stay sharp. I did not come this far to fall behind.
I have to keep up with you somehow. Today that is a win.
Do not give up. Come back when you are ready.
That was incredible. You have really earned it.
I am proud to call you my rival, and I mean it.
One last duel is coming. Make it count.
This is it for me, you and I, no tricks and no holding back.
We started as rivals, and I want to see how far we both got.
I trained for this duel every single day. Show me your best!
That is my best. I hope it was worth the wait!
So close! You can beat me, I know you can.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_neshi_01.o: Well fought. The shrine sees it.
You carry yourself with respect. Go in peace.
Ekayon will hear of this duel.
Ekayon trusts me to hold this ground.
Show me your strength, Outsider. Honestly.
The shrine stands, and so do I.
Come back when your bond runs deeper.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_ophelia_cr: An error in my model. Noted and corrected.
Interesting. You are more than a variable.
Lysandre will hear of this. Coldly, and in detail.
I have calculated this battle. You are the error.
Every raid is a plan. You are a small detail.
Let us be efficient. Two Pokemon, one result.
Exactly as predicted. The raid continues.
Pity. The odds were never in your favor.
How do you keep breaking my plans?!
I will not forgive this. Lysandre will see me prevail.
I recalculated everything. You will not escape twice.
Flare returns in force, and I lead the line.
Last time was a data point. Today is a result.
As the new model predicted. Do not rise again.
Your defeat was always in the numbers.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_pablo_ferr: I knew it. I was too nervous, but that was great!
You are so strong! I will train harder, I promise.
Thanks for not laughing at me. Good fight!
Um, hi! I am still new at this. Please go easy on me.
My hands are shaking, but I will do my best!
Okay, deep breath. I can do this. I think.
I won? Really?! I cannot believe it. Sorry, newcomer!
Oh wow, I actually did it. Thank you for the battle.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_pertinax_0: Hmph. Strong, I will give you that.
Winning a duel changes nothing. My mind stays.
Do not mistake my silence for surrender.
You do not belong here, Outsider.
I will not bend. Not for you, not for anyone.
Go back through your rift. I will make you.
As I said. This world has no room for you.
Leave. Before the balance breaks further.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_prof_ansel: You fought with real instinct. I am impressed.
Remember this one. It belongs in a museum.
Ah, a challenger! Let us see what you have dug up.
Old Pokemon taught me patience. Let us begin.
Every battle is a fossil of a lesson.
Fascinating. Study the loss, it is a fine artifact.
Do come back. I would love to see you improve.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_ranger_isa: Good work! You handle wild danger like a true ranger.
I will log this in my report. You helped a lot.
Keep your guard up, there may be more of them.
Stay back! Something strange is moving near the rifts.
These Pokemon are not acting like themselves. I must stop them.
Stand with me, Outsider, and I will see how you battle.
Careful now! The danger is real. Do not rush in.
Get some rest. I will keep watch for you.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_richard_nu: Remarkable. Your results exceeded my predictions.
The numbers do not lie. You are strong.
Well done. The work you do will matter.
Welcome. I have waited a long time to see how far you have come.
Science taught me to test everything. Let us test you.
The field is charged. Show me what you can do.
Interesting data. You will do better with more experience.
A good attempt. Analyze your mistakes and try again.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_rory_calla: Well fought! Your strength honors this duel.
I yield. You carry real valor, newcomer.
Keep that fire. You will do well here.
Step up, newcomer! A trial of strength awaits.
I fight with honor. Show me your resolve.
No tricks, no shortcuts. Just courage. Begin!
Your courage is real, but you need more strength.
Do not lose heart. Rise and try again.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_sergeant_e: You earned this one. Do not let it go to your head.
Stand straight. I keep order here, and I fight fair.
Eyes front. Show me discipline, not just power.
Ready when you are. No excuses afterward.
Order wins again. Review your mistakes.
Not bad, but strength alone is not enough.
That is the discipline I was looking for.
You have earned this respect. Stand proud.
Last inspection. I hold nothing back.
Order is earned every day. Prove you earned yours.
Discipline wins. Come back when you have it.
You were close. Closer is not enough.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_silas_rook: Grr! Strong. But my loyalty stays unbroken.
This is not the end. Lysandre still watches.
Hmph. Enjoy it while it lasts.
Lysandre gave me one order. Break whoever stands here.
You walked right into it. That was a mistake.
I do not talk. I crush.
Crushed, like all who stand in his way.
Get up if you can. I will wait.
No! I trained for this, and you still stand!
Lysandre... forgive me. I will not fail again.
I have been waiting for this. No holding back now.
Last time I went easy. Not again.
Lysandre's will is my fury. Fall!
Stay down. Do not make me repeat it.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_tiago_lemo: You broke my guard! Fair winds to you, friend.
I never saw that squall coming. Good battle.
Go aboard. You have earned it.
Ahoy there! No one boards this ship without a challenge.
I have kept watch all night, and I am ready for you.
Steady now. Let us see if you can handle rough seas.
Smooth sailing for me today! Come back with more grit.
The watch holds. Better luck on the next tide.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_tomas_reye: Whoa, you broke my whole setup!
Back to the workbench for me. Great fight.
I need to rebuild this plan. Thanks for the data.
Hold on, calibrating. Okay, I am ready!
Let me test my machines against your team.
Two Pokemon, one system. Watch the timing.
Ha, the numbers held up! Run it again.
Failure is just data. Take notes, friend.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_ulda_01.on: You fought with honor. I will say so.
Pass, then. But the land watches you.
Pertinax will not be pleased. I am not sorry.
This border is not yours to cross.
Pertinax speaks, and I stand ready.
A duel of honor. Prove you are worthy.
You are not ready. Turn back.
The land refuses you. Leave this border.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_wanda_01.o: Well, that was a steep hill! You win fair and square.
I need a long rest after that one, honestly.
Watch your step on the road ahead, it gets rough.
Nice day for a hike, and a battle! Ready, traveler?
I have climbed every ridge around here, so do not underestimate me.
My Pokemon are tough as mountain stone!
Ha! Mountain rock does not crumble that easily.
Keep climbing, friend. You will get there, trust me.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.might_zuri_nakam: Incredible! You found my weak spot!
Best fight I have had since the last cave-in.
Okay, okay, you win. Treasure goes to you!
Hah, a duel! Almost as fun as a collapsing ruin.
I fear nothing, not traps, not curses, not you!
Let us see what you are made of!
Ha! Another trap you did not see coming.
Do not worry, everyone falls in the first pit.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.relic_a_z_01.on_: So the rift chose well. Remember this fight.
Strength is not enough. Learn what it protects.
Go on. The road ahead needs you.
I have waited a very long time for someone to stand where you stand.
Show me what you carry through the rift, traveler.
Do not hold back. I will not.
Not yet. You are not ready to bear what is coming.
Rest, traveler. Then come back stronger.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.relic_a_z_02.on_: At last. Someone who can bear what I could not.
Go. The world has need of you more than I do.
We meet again. This time I will hold nothing back.
Long have I carried my sorrow. Let it be settled here.
Show me what the rift has made of you.
Even now, it is not enough. I am sorry, traveler.
The wait goes on. Go and heal.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.relic_brann_01.o: Hmph. Your bond is real. I will admit that.
I yield. This duel was fought with honor.
Go on. But I will be watching you.
No Outsider crosses this ground without proving worth.
I guard this border. Raise your Pokemon.
Pertinax asked for strength. I will give him some.
You are not ready for what lies past here.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.relic_captain_ar: Haha! Now that is power! You earned that win!
My muscles are sore and my heart is happy. Well done!
You are strong, no question. I am proud to have fought you.
Stand tall! Power solves everything, so show me yours!
My partner and I have faced hundreds of fights. Bring it on!
Come on, no holding back. Strength is honest!
Ha! That is the power of a true bond! Train harder!
Good effort! Keep growing and come back stronger.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.relic_captain_pe: Well I'll be. You reeled me in fair and square.
Good battle, friend. Strong current in you.
Mind the water out there. It remembers everything.
Easy now, stranger. The fish are slow today, but my team is not.
Cast your line, newcomer. Let us see what you pull in.
Twenty years of waiting on tides. I have patience to spare.
Ha! The old tide still beats a fresh wave, friend.
Do not fret. Even good fishers lose a few lines.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.relic_cleo_march: Fascinating. You are worth more than I guessed.
Well fought! Keep that spirit, it is a rare treasure.
Consider this a fine welcome to the New World.
So you are the one who came through the rift. Show me what you have.
A curious find on my doorstep. Let me see what you are made of.
Do not hold back. I would hate to be bored.
Not bad for a first step, but I am not easily impressed.
Come back when you have gathered a bit more luck.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.relic_crystal_is: Marvelous. You are a treasure I did not expect to find.
I have never held a prize quite like this victory of yours.
Go with my respect. You have earned it.
Welcome to my collection. Today you are the rarest piece in it.
I love beautiful things. I hope your strength is one of them.
The sun is bright and the wind is with me. Shall we begin?
A fine fight, but my collection is safe for now.
Do not be disheartened. Rare things take time to shine.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.relic_dax_moreau: Hm. You have power. I will admit it, just this once.
A fair loss. Do not think I will let it happen again.
Remember my name. We will fight again.
So you are the Outsider. Show me whether you are worth my time.
I only duel those who can fight. Prove you can.
Do not disappoint me. Strength deserves a real opponent.
Not yet strong enough. Come back when you have trained.
I respect the effort. But effort is not enough.
Impressive. You have earned my attention.
I lost, and I will not pretend otherwise. Well fought.
Next time I will not lose.
You again. Good. I wanted to see if you had grown.
Since our last duel I trained harder. Do you see the gap?
Show me strength worth respecting.
You are improving, but I am still ahead.
Keep climbing. I will be waiting at the top.
Hah. You beat me fair and square. I respect that.
Strength like yours is worth chasing. I will catch you.
Good duel. Truly.
Strong opponents are rare here. You are one of them.
I fight with pride and I expect the same from you.
Let us see which of us is stronger today.
Pride must be backed by power. Today mine was.
You fought well. Do not stop now.
Good. That is the strength this world needs.
I have nothing left to teach you in a duel.
Go on. I will keep up, do not worry.
The danger is real now. I need to know you can handle it.
I am not here to hold you back. I am here to test you.
Fight like it matters, because it does.
Not yet. A stronger fighter is needed. Train more.
You are close. Do not waste what you have.
You have surpassed me. I say it with respect.
A great fighter beat me today. No shame in that.
One last duel remains. Be ready.
We have come far. I will not lose my pride at this stage.
I want a duel worthy of everything we have done.
Give me everything you have. I will do the same.
My strength held. But you made it close.
I will not call it easy. You are formidable.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.relic_dr_amara_e: Remarkable! I must write this battle down at once.
You fight like someone who has crossed worlds. I believe it.
Go on, but tread softly near the old stones.
Oh, a visitor! Forgive the dust, I have been digging all morning.
These ruins hold secrets, and my Pokemon help me protect them.
Let us see what you are made of, friend from the rift.
Fascinating! Please note how that went, for my records.
The ruins win today. Do come back when you are rested.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.relic_dr_ingrid_: Excellent! That result changes my calculations.
Good work. Your results go straight in my notes.
Remarkable. Let us train again soon.
Perfect timing. I need live data on your team.
Training match! Do not hold back, I take notes.
The rifts taught me to expect anything. Show me.
Fascinating. Your weak points are now on record.
Review your tactics, then we run it again.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.relic_dr_mordeca: A flawed experiment! I must rerun the numbers.
Lysandre will not like this report.
Interesting. You are more than a variable.
Hold still, specimen. The rifts are my study, and you are a fine variable.
Lord Lysandre needs data, and your Pokemon will provide it.
This is purely scientific. Try not to scream.
Fascinating. Entirely as predicted. Take notes, subject.
Your results are poor. I will file them.
You fight to protect, not to take. I see it.
Good. The world needed to see that.
I will not stand against you. Not today.
I do not hate you. I need to know who you are.
My people are hurt. Show me you can be trusted.
Lucario, Zeraora, Zoroark. We face you as one.
Your resolve is not yet steady. Think on that.
Strength alone fixes nothing. Learn more.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.relic_elder_pax_: Well done. You have a good heart and a steady hand.
Hear me: someone is coming. Be ready.
Peace to you, Outsider. Remember this day.
Ah, an Outsider. Come, let us talk with our Pokemon.
Peace is not weakness, child. Shall we begin?
Slowking and I have time. Do you?
Do not be sad. Every fall teaches something.
Slowly, child. Slowly. Come back when ready.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.relic_flare_digg: Ow, my back! I only wanted the shiny stuff.
Fine, fine, I lost. The hole was not that deep anyway.
Lysandre pays me to dig, not to lose!
Hah! Dug up a visitor instead of treasure. Fine by me!
My shovel is dull but my Pokemon are not.
Boss wants the ground emptied. You are in the way!
Dig deep, kid. You got buried!
Back to the pit with you. Ha!
dialogs.steamon_trainer.relic_flare_grun: Ash is all I have left. Ugh!
Hey, that was a fluke! Next time you burn.
Lysandre is going to be so mad at me.
Heh, you picked the wrong day to snoop around.
Team Flare does not lose to nobodies. Get ready!
I will burn you down to ash. Get it? Ash!
Too easy! Flare rules, loser!
Cry about it somewhere else.
Dust?! No, you got lucky!
Tch, I got swept instead. Humiliating.
The boss will hear about this, I swear.
Look what crawled in. Let me throw you out with the trash.
You are a speck of dust to Team Flare!
Step aside or get swept aside.
Swept away, just like I said. Pathetic!
Scram, dust. Flare is busy.
Dulled by a nobody. Ouch.
You were sharper than I thought.
Okay okay, you pass. Do not tell anyone I said that.
Halt! Flare territory. You get a pointy welcome from me.
I am the sharpest grunt in Team Flare. Prove me wrong!
One poke and you will fold, outsider.
Poked and dropped. Sharp as ever!
Come back when you are less soft.
That was not in the script!
I must rewrite my report. This is bad.
Fine, you win this page. The story is not over.
Write this down, I am about to beat you.
Team Flare took notes on you. You lose in the first line.
My Pokemon are ready, and my pen is mightier!
Chapter closed. You lost, as written.
Better luck in your next draft.
No way. I had the boss's attention!
Fine, fine. Just do not tell the Admins.
This was supposed to be easy money.
Flare sent me to clear the path. You are the path.
Step aside, Outsider. Or get stepped on.
Lysandre wants this world, and I want a bonus.
Ha! Told you. Flare does not lose.
Go home, if you can find the rift.
Tch. The Admins will not like this.
You got lucky. Next time I bring friends.
Fine. Take your win and get lost.
Nothing personal. Orders are orders.
Team Flare is everywhere now. You are late.
Show me what an Outsider is worth.
Easy. Flare takes another step forward.
You should have stayed through the rift.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.relic_flare_hack: My Pokemon... but the data is safe with me.
Beaten by a trainer, not a firewall. Humiliating.
Keep it. I copied everything anyway.
Your machine's secrets are already on my screen.
I did not come to fight, but sure, why not.
One battle and I still walk out with the data.
Download complete. Thanks for the distraction.
Too slow. My files are already gone.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.relic_flare_raid: The raid is not over. I only lost a round.
You hit harder than the others did.
Raid time! Hold the line if you can!
We hit hard and fast. Try to keep up!
Weak defense. The raid goes on.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.relic_jax_mercer: Fine, fine, you win this one. Keep your treasure.
Tough luck for me. I will find a better spot.
You dig deep, newcomer. I respect that.
Hey! That ruin is mine. Fight me for the loot!
Found it first, friend. Want it? Earn it.
Every treasure has a price. Mine is a good battle.
Ha! Finders keepers. Better luck digging next time.
Told you. The loot is mine, and so is the win.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.relic_kenji_aoki: Well fought. Your discipline is real.
A clean victory. I respect that.
Keep training. You will go far.
Discipline first, then power. Show me both.
Bow, then fight. That is how we begin.
I train fighters. Let me see if you are one.
Your form is loose. Train, then return.
Strength without discipline is noise. Again.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.relic_king_of_th: The crown wobbles! You have earned my respect, traveler.
The flock is stunned, but proud of you.
Go forth, challenger. The throne will remember you.
Bow before the King of the Wooloo! Fluffy, loyal, and mighty!
My royal flock has never lost a bleating contest!
Approach, traveler, and face the wool of destiny!
The crown stays on my head! Long live the wool!
Fear not, even kings lose to nobody today. Hahaha!
The crown falls! You have bested the King of the Wooloo.
After all this time, you still surprise me.
The flock bows to you. Wear your victory well.
The King returns! The flock has grown mightier, traveler!
I have trained through every storm. This crown is heavier now.
Prepare yourself! This is the royal rematch!
The throne holds! Wool conquers all, once more!
Even after everything, the flock stays unbeaten. Hahaha!
dialogs.steamon_trainer.relic_kitu_01.on: You fought with care. I will tell the others.
The way is open. Walk it gently.
I saw something honest in you today.
I watch the Outsiders. Now I watch how you fight.
The border is quiet. Let us see if you are too.
Show me what you carry in your heart, Outsider.
The path stays closed for now. Come back stronger.
You walk loudly. The land hears it.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.relic_lysandre_0: Impossible. I have planned for everything but you.
This changes nothing. I will find another way.
You may have won today. I do not forget.
You are too late. The world is already forgetting what it lost.
I was sent here last, and I came back with a purpose.
I will not stop. Stand aside, or be removed.
Pathetic. Nothing will stand in the way of my plan.
This is how it ends for those who resist me.
No! Not again! I was so close to fixing everything!
How can you keep standing against me?
This is not over. It cannot be over.
I lost everything once. I will not lose it again!
Everything I did was for a better world. You will not take it!
Enough games. This ends here, and I win!
You see? You could never stop me. Now step aside.
The future is mine, and the world will burn bright.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.relic_maren_solb: You swept me away like a wave! Nicely done.
I have not felt tides like that on land before.
The sea has more to show you. Keep exploring.
The sea taught me patience, so I will not rush you.
I have seen wonders in the deep. Let me show you one.
Take a deep breath, the water is cold out here.
The current carried me today. Keep swimming, friend.
Deep waters are not easy. Come back stronger.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.relic_marlo_01.o: Okay, okay. You beat me. Do not let it go to your head.
Hm. A lone wolf can respect a good rival.
Next time I will be stronger. Count on it.
Hey you! I take on anyone. Today that is you.
No team, no rules, just a good fight. Ready?
Nobody beat me yet. Let us see if you do.
Ha! Still undefeated on this road. Try again sometime.
Not today, newcomer. The road is mine.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.relic_marlo_02.o: Ugh, you grew too. Fine, you earned it.
Hard times make us stronger, and you proved it.
I will chase you down for a third round.
Back again? I have grown stronger since our last fight.
Things changed around here, but I did not lose my edge.
Round two. No holding back this time.
Still the road's best. You will need more than that.
I trained for this. Did you?
dialogs.steamon_trainer.relic_mira_okoye: Whoa, you are good! Okay, I am officially jealous.
Fine, you win this one. But I am going to train twice as hard.
Good fight! Do not get comfortable, I will catch up.
Hey, you are the Outsider from the rift! I am Mira. Battle me?
I am going to find the first relic, and you are not beating me to it!
Friendly match, sure. But I am playing to win!
Ha! One point to me. Do not sulk, you will get better.
That was fun! Next time bring your best, I will.
Okay, you earned that one. You keep surprising me.
Ugh, I was so sure! Fine, you are officially my rival.
I will be back stronger. Count on it.
Look who is back! I have been training since our last match.
No hard feelings, but I am not losing to you twice!
Ready? I have a few new tricks to show off.
Yes! Told you I would improve. Better luck next time!
I won this time, but you made me work for it.
Wow. You are getting scary good, you know that?
Fine, fine, you win. But I am right behind you!
That was a real fight. I needed that.
There you are! I knew we would meet again out here.
I have seen things that changed how I fight. Let me show you.
This is not just a game for me anymore. Go all out!
I did not want to win like this, but I am not holding back.
You are close, I can feel it. Keep pushing!
You are ahead of me. I hate it and I love it.
Okay, now I really have something to prove.
Go. I will meet you at the top, just wait.
Things are getting serious, so I am not going easy on you.
Every time we fight, I learn something. Teach me more!
Stay sharp. I did not come this far to fall behind.
I have to keep up with you somehow. Today that is a win.
Do not give up. Come back when you are ready.
That was incredible. You have really earned it.
I am proud to call you my rival, and I mean it.
One last duel is coming. Make it count.
This is it for me, you and I, no tricks and no holding back.
We started as rivals, and I want to see how far we both got.
I trained for this duel every single day. Show me your best!
That is my best. I hope it was worth the wait!
So close! You can beat me, I know you can.
You did it. You are the better trainer, and I am glad it was you.
Best rival anyone could ask for. Thank you, truly.
Go on. I will be cheering from right here.
Last duel, no more warm ups. Everything I have, right now!
We have raced all this way. Let us see who is faster!
Do not hold back, or I will never forgive you!
I won! After all this, I actually won. Wow.
You gave me everything and I am grateful for it.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.relic_ophelia_cr: An error in my model. Noted and corrected.
Interesting. You are more than a variable.
Lysandre will hear of this. Coldly, and in detail.
I have calculated this battle. You are the error.
Every raid is a plan. You are a small detail.
Let us be efficient. Two Pokemon, one result.
Exactly as predicted. The raid continues.
Pity. The odds were never in your favor.
How do you keep breaking my plans?!
I will not forgive this. Lysandre will see me prevail.
I recalculated everything. You will not escape twice.
Flare returns in force, and I lead the line.
Last time was a data point. Today is a result.
As the new model predicted. Do not rise again.
Your defeat was always in the numbers.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.relic_pertinax_0: Hmph. Strong, I will give you that.
Winning a duel changes nothing. My mind stays.
Do not mistake my silence for surrender.
You do not belong here, Outsider.
I will not bend. Not for you, not for anyone.
Go back through your rift. I will make you.
As I said. This world has no room for you.
Leave. Before the balance breaks further.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.relic_prof_ansel: You fought with real instinct. I am impressed.
Remember this one. It belongs in a museum.
Ah, a challenger! Let us see what you have dug up.
Old Pokemon taught me patience. Let us begin.
Every battle is a fossil of a lesson.
Fascinating. Study the loss, it is a fine artifact.
Do come back. I would love to see you improve.
Remarkable. You are a living discovery.
My collection has nothing quite like you.
Fairly beaten. I could not ask for more.
Welcome back. This time I brought my rarest finds.
Ancient power is no museum piece. Feel it.
Let us see how far you have come.
Even a fine specimen can be outmatched.
Study this loss well. Then return stronger.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.relic_ranger_isa: Good work! You handle wild danger like a true ranger.
I will log this in my report. You helped a lot.
Keep your guard up, there may be more of them.
Stay back! Something strange is moving near the rifts.
These Pokemon are not acting like themselves. I must stop them.
Stand with me, Outsider, and I will see how you battle.
Careful now! The danger is real. Do not rush in.
Get some rest. I will keep watch for you.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.relic_richard_nu: Remarkable. Your results exceeded my predictions.
The numbers do not lie. You are strong.
Well done. The work you do will matter.
Welcome. I have waited a long time to see how far you have come.
Science taught me to test everything. Let us test you.
The field is charged. Show me what you can do.
Interesting data. You will do better with more experience.
A good attempt. Analyze your mistakes and try again.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.relic_sael_01.on: Your bond with your Pokemon is true. I see it clearly.
The forest listens to you now, and so do I.
Take my word to those who wish to listen.
Peace, Outsider. I am Sael, and I carry words from my people.
Trust is not given with words. Show me your heart in battle.
Let the Pokemon speak for both of us.
Trust takes time. Do not lose heart, we may try again.
The path is not closed. It only asks for patience.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.relic_sergeant_e: You earned this one. Do not let it go to your head.
Stand straight. I keep order here, and I fight fair.
Eyes front. Show me discipline, not just power.
Ready when you are. No excuses afterward.
Order wins again. Review your mistakes.
Not bad, but strength alone is not enough.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.relic_silas_rook: Grr! Strong. But my loyalty stays unbroken.
This is not the end. Lysandre still watches.
Hmph. Enjoy it while it lasts.
Lysandre gave me one order. Break whoever stands here.
You walked right into it. That was a mistake.
I do not talk. I crush.
Crushed, like all who stand in his way.
Get up if you can. I will wait.
No! I trained for this, and you still stand!
Lysandre... forgive me. I will not fail again.
I have been waiting for this. No holding back now.
Last time I went easy. Not again.
Lysandre's will is my fury. Fall!
Stay down. Do not make me repeat it.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.relic_tilda_rowe: Well climbed! You keep a fine pace.
The ruins will welcome a trainer like you.
Ha! Take the next trail, I will follow.
Old caves hide old secrets. Mind your step.
I have walked many ruins. Let me see your pace.
Easy now. A good hike starts slow.
Steady legs win the long road. Rest a bit.
The mountain teaches patience. Try again.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.relic_tomas_reye: Whoa, you broke my whole setup!
Back to the workbench for me. Great fight.
I need to rebuild this plan. Thanks for the data.
Hold on, calibrating. Okay, I am ready!
Let me test my machines against your team.
Two Pokemon, one system. Watch the timing.
Ha, the numbers held up! Run it again.
Failure is just data. Take notes, friend.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.relic_wanda_01.o: Well, that was a steep hill! You win fair and square.
I need a long rest after that one, honestly.
Watch your step on the road ahead, it gets rough.
Nice day for a hike, and a battle! Ready, traveler?
I have climbed every ridge around here, so do not underestimate me.
My Pokemon are tough as mountain stone!
Ha! Mountain rock does not crumble that easily.
Keep climbing, friend. You will get there, trust me.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.relic_zuri_nakam: Incredible! You found my weak spot!
Best fight I have had since the last cave-in.
Okay, okay, you win. Treasure goes to you!
Hah, a duel! Almost as fun as a collapsing ruin.
I fear nothing, not traps, not curses, not you!
Let us see what you are made of!
Ha! Another trap you did not see coming.
Do not worry, everyone falls in the first pit.
Magnificent! You found the hidden chamber!
I lost, and I could not be happier.
Now that is a treasure of a fight.
The deepest ruins taught me new tricks!
No map, no fear, no mercy. Let us go!
Round two, and I found something big.
Ha! The ruins always claim the careless!
Better luck next dig. I loved every second.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.spark_a_z_01.on_: So the rift chose well. Remember this fight.
Strength is not enough. Learn what it protects.
Go on. The road ahead needs you.
I have waited a very long time for someone to stand where you stand.
Show me what you carry through the rift, traveler.
Do not hold back. I will not.
Not yet. You are not ready to bear what is coming.
Rest, traveler. Then come back stronger.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.spark_a_z_02.on_: At last. Someone who can bear what I could not.
Go. The world has need of you more than I do.
We meet again. This time I will hold nothing back.
Long have I carried my sorrow. Let it be settled here.
Show me what the rift has made of you.
Even now, it is not enough. I am sorry, traveler.
The wait goes on. Go and heal.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.spark_brann_01.o: Hmph. Your bond is real. I will admit that.
I yield. This duel was fought with honor.
Go on. But I will be watching you.
No Outsider crosses this ground without proving worth.
I guard this border. Raise your Pokemon.
Pertinax asked for strength. I will give him some.
You are not ready for what lies past here.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.spark_captain_ar: Haha! Now that is power! You earned that win!
My muscles are sore and my heart is happy. Well done!
You are strong, no question. I am proud to have fought you.
Stand tall! Power solves everything, so show me yours!
My partner and I have faced hundreds of fights. Bring it on!
Come on, no holding back. Strength is honest!
Ha! That is the power of a true bond! Train harder!
Good effort! Keep growing and come back stronger.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.spark_captain_pe: Well I'll be. You reeled me in fair and square.
Good battle, friend. Strong current in you.
Mind the water out there. It remembers everything.
Easy now, stranger. The fish are slow today, but my team is not.
Cast your line, newcomer. Let us see what you pull in.
Twenty years of waiting on tides. I have patience to spare.
Ha! The old tide still beats a fresh wave, friend.
Do not fret. Even good fishers lose a few lines.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.spark_crystal_is: Marvelous. You are a treasure I did not expect to find.
I have never held a prize quite like this victory of yours.
Go with my respect. You have earned it.
Welcome to my collection. Today you are the rarest piece in it.
I love beautiful things. I hope your strength is one of them.
The sun is bright and the wind is with me. Shall we begin?
A fine fight, but my collection is safe for now.
Do not be disheartened. Rare things take time to shine.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.spark_daro_01.on: A fair duel. The shrine is open to you.
You fought with respect. That is rare.
The shrine is sacred. You will face me first.
Ekayon trusts few. I trust his judgment, and my claws.
Fight well, Outsider. The shrine is watching.
The shrine is not for you. Not yet.
Rest, and return with a clearer mind.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.spark_dax_moreau: Hm. You have power. I will admit it, just this once.
A fair loss. Do not think I will let it happen again.
Remember my name. We will fight again.
So you are the Outsider. Show me whether you are worth my time.
I only duel those who can fight. Prove you can.
Do not disappoint me. Strength deserves a real opponent.
Not yet strong enough. Come back when you have trained.
I respect the effort. But effort is not enough.
Impressive. You have earned my attention.
I lost, and I will not pretend otherwise. Well fought.
Next time I will not lose.
You again. Good. I wanted to see if you had grown.
Since our last duel I trained harder. Do you see the gap?
Show me strength worth respecting.
You are improving, but I am still ahead.
Keep climbing. I will be waiting at the top.
Hah. You beat me fair and square. I respect that.
Strength like yours is worth chasing. I will catch you.
Good duel. Truly.
Strong opponents are rare here. You are one of them.
I fight with pride and I expect the same from you.
Let us see which of us is stronger today.
Pride must be backed by power. Today mine was.
You fought well. Do not stop now.
Good. That is the strength this world needs.
I have nothing left to teach you in a duel.
Go on. I will keep up, do not worry.
The danger is real now. I need to know you can handle it.
I am not here to hold you back. I am here to test you.
Fight like it matters, because it does.
Not yet. A stronger fighter is needed. Train more.
You are close. Do not waste what you have.
You have surpassed me. I say it with respect.
A great fighter beat me today. No shame in that.
One last duel remains. Be ready.
We have come far. I will not lose my pride at this stage.
I want a duel worthy of everything we have done.
Give me everything you have. I will do the same.
My strength held. But you made it close.
I will not call it easy. You are formidable.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.spark_director_e: Impossible. I calculated every outcome but this one.
The rifts will outlast us all. Do not think this is over.
Fine. Take your victory. It will cost you more than you think.
Everything I did, I did to learn. You will not stand in my way.
The rifts are worth more than you know. I will not give them up.
Let us see how far your loyalty takes you.
Progress needs sacrifices. You were simply one of them.
Go home. The work continues without you.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.spark_dr_ingrid_: Excellent! That result changes my calculations.
Good work. Your results go straight in my notes.
Remarkable. Let us train again soon.
Perfect timing. I need live data on your team.
Training match! Do not hold back, I take notes.
The rifts taught me to expect anything. Show me.
Fascinating. Your weak points are now on record.
Review your tactics, then we run it again.
My models were wrong, and I am glad of it.
Brilliant. You broke my best calculation.
You have earned my respect, and my notes.
I have studied the rifts for years. Today I test you.
My full team, my full focus. Do not blink.
Every variable accounted for. Except you.
As my models predicted. Study harder.
Close, but data does not lie. Try again.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.spark_dr_mordeca: A flawed experiment! I must rerun the numbers.
Lysandre will not like this report.
Interesting. You are more than a variable.
Hold still, specimen. The rifts are my study, and you are a fine variable.
Lord Lysandre needs data, and your Pokemon will provide it.
This is purely scientific. Try not to scream.
Fascinating. Entirely as predicted. Take notes, subject.
Your results are poor. I will file them.
No! Years of work, ruined by one Outsider!
The data was perfect. You broke my formula.
Lysandre will make you pay for this, you will see.
The lab falls today. My research will not be wasted on you!
Lord Lysandre is coming back, and I will clear his path.
Years of data went into this team. Face it!
Data confirmed. You lose, as every model said.
Another failed subject. Clear the room.
You fight to protect, not to take. I see it.
Good. The world needed to see that.
I will not stand against you. Not today.
I do not hate you. I need to know who you are.
My people are hurt. Show me you can be trusted.
Lucario, Zeraora, Zoroark. We face you as one.
Your resolve is not yet steady. Think on that.
Strength alone fixes nothing. Learn more.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.spark_felix_aard: That was not in my data at all. Impressive.
Hm, I need to recalibrate everything after that loss.
Be careful out there, the rifts are getting worse.
Hold on, the rift readings just spiked. Good timing, honestly.
I track the unstable rifts, but a battle is a fine data point too.
Let me run the numbers on you, Outsider.
Predicted outcome confirmed. Sorry, no hard feelings.
My model said I would win. Do not take it personally.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.spark_flare_digg: Ow, my back! I only wanted the shiny stuff.
Fine, fine, I lost. The hole was not that deep anyway.
Lysandre pays me to dig, not to lose!
Hah! Dug up a visitor instead of treasure. Fine by me!
My shovel is dull but my Pokemon are not.
Boss wants the ground emptied. You are in the way!
Dig deep, kid. You got buried!
Back to the pit with you. Ha!
dialogs.steamon_trainer.spark_flare_grun: Ash is all I have left. Ugh!
Hey, that was a fluke! Next time you burn.
Lysandre is going to be so mad at me.
Heh, you picked the wrong day to snoop around.
Team Flare does not lose to nobodies. Get ready!
I will burn you down to ash. Get it? Ash!
Too easy! Flare rules, loser!
Cry about it somewhere else.
Dust?! No, you got lucky!
Tch, I got swept instead. Humiliating.
The boss will hear about this, I swear.
Look what crawled in. Let me throw you out with the trash.
You are a speck of dust to Team Flare!
Step aside or get swept aside.
Swept away, just like I said. Pathetic!
Scram, dust. Flare is busy.
Dulled by a nobody. Ouch.
You were sharper than I thought.
Okay okay, you pass. Do not tell anyone I said that.
Halt! Flare territory. You get a pointy welcome from me.
I am the sharpest grunt in Team Flare. Prove me wrong!
One poke and you will fold, outsider.
Poked and dropped. Sharp as ever!
Come back when you are less soft.
That was not in the script!
I must rewrite my report. This is bad.
Fine, you win this page. The story is not over.
Write this down, I am about to beat you.
Team Flare took notes on you. You lose in the first line.
My Pokemon are ready, and my pen is mightier!
Chapter closed. You lost, as written.
Better luck in your next draft.
No way. I had the boss's attention!
Fine, fine. Just do not tell the Admins.
This was supposed to be easy money.
Flare sent me to clear the path. You are the path.
Step aside, Outsider. Or get stepped on.
Lysandre wants this world, and I want a bonus.
Ha! Told you. Flare does not lose.
Go home, if you can find the rift.
Tch. The Admins will not like this.
You got lucky. Next time I bring friends.
Fine. Take your win and get lost.
Nothing personal. Orders are orders.
Team Flare is everywhere now. You are late.
Show me what an Outsider is worth.
Easy. Flare takes another step forward.
You should have stayed through the rift.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.spark_flare_hack: My Pokemon... but the data is safe with me.
Beaten by a trainer, not a firewall. Humiliating.
Keep it. I copied everything anyway.
Your machine's secrets are already on my screen.
I did not come to fight, but sure, why not.
One battle and I still walk out with the data.
Download complete. Thanks for the distraction.
Too slow. My files are already gone.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.spark_flare_raid: The raid is not over. I only lost a round.
You hit harder than the others did.
Raid time! Hold the line if you can!
We hit hard and fast. Try to keep up!
Weak defense. The raid goes on.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.spark_hesk_01.on: Tch. You earned that win, I suppose.
My stance holds, but you fought well.
Pertinax will hear of this. Pass.
Pertinax does not like visitors. Neither do I.
Turn around, Outsider, or lose here.
This border is mine to hold. Let us begin.
Too weak. Go back where you came from.
The Overworld has no room for the careless.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.spark_ilu_01.on_: You are patient and strong. Well done.
I step aside. The shrine accepts you.
Walk softly in there. It is a holy place.
I guard the shrine, Outsider. Do not rush me.
Ekayon asked me to hold this place. I will.
The shrine stays quiet today. Try again later.
You rushed. The Overworld rewards patience.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.spark_kenji_aoki: Well fought. Your discipline is real.
A clean victory. I respect that.
Keep training. You will go far.
Discipline first, then power. Show me both.
Bow, then fight. That is how we begin.
I train fighters. Let me see if you are one.
Your form is loose. Train, then return.
Strength without discipline is noise. Again.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.spark_king_of_th: The crown wobbles! You have earned my respect, traveler.
The flock is stunned, but proud of you.
Go forth, challenger. The throne will remember you.
Bow before the King of the Wooloo! Fluffy, loyal, and mighty!
My royal flock has never lost a bleating contest!
Approach, traveler, and face the wool of destiny!
The crown stays on my head! Long live the wool!
Fear not, even kings lose to nobody today. Hahaha!
The crown falls! You have bested the King of the Wooloo.
After all this time, you still surprise me.
The flock bows to you. Wear your victory well.
The King returns! The flock has grown mightier, traveler!
I have trained through every storm. This crown is heavier now.
Prepare yourself! This is the royal rematch!
The throne holds! Wool conquers all, once more!
Even after everything, the flock stays unbeaten. Hahaha!
dialogs.steamon_trainer.spark_kitu_01.on: You fought with care. I will tell the others.
The way is open. Walk it gently.
I saw something honest in you today.
I watch the Outsiders. Now I watch how you fight.
The border is quiet. Let us see if you are too.
Show me what you carry in your heart, Outsider.
The path stays closed for now. Come back stronger.
You walk loudly. The land hears it.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.spark_lena_ortiz: Whoa, a flaw in my setup! I need to rework that.
Great fight. You stress-tested my plan perfectly.
Next version will be better. Thanks for the data!
Hold on, let me check my gears. Okay, ready to test this build!
My Pokemon run like clockwork. Care to see?
Tinkering is fun, but a battle is the real test.
Looks like my design held up. Back to the workbench for you.
Efficiency wins. Maybe tweak your strategy, newcomer.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.spark_lysandre_0: Impossible. I have planned for everything but you.
This changes nothing. I will find another way.
You may have won today. I do not forget.
You are too late. The world is already forgetting what it lost.
I was sent here last, and I came back with a purpose.
I will not stop. Stand aside, or be removed.
Pathetic. Nothing will stand in the way of my plan.
This is how it ends for those who resist me.
No! Not again! I was so close to fixing everything!
How can you keep standing against me?
This is not over. It cannot be over.
I lost everything once. I will not lose it again!
Everything I did was for a better world. You will not take it!
Enough games. This ends here, and I win!
You see? You could never stop me. Now step aside.
The future is mine, and the world will burn bright.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.spark_marlo_01.o: Okay, okay. You beat me. Do not let it go to your head.
Hm. A lone wolf can respect a good rival.
Next time I will be stronger. Count on it.
Hey you! I take on anyone. Today that is you.
No team, no rules, just a good fight. Ready?
Nobody beat me yet. Let us see if you do.
Ha! Still undefeated on this road. Try again sometime.
Not today, newcomer. The road is mine.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.spark_marlo_02.o: Ugh, you grew too. Fine, you earned it.
Hard times make us stronger, and you proved it.
I will chase you down for a third round.
Back again? I have grown stronger since our last fight.
Things changed around here, but I did not lose my edge.
Round two. No holding back this time.
Still the road's best. You will need more than that.
I trained for this. Did you?
dialogs.steamon_trainer.spark_mira_okoye: Whoa, you are good! Okay, I am officially jealous.
Fine, you win this one. But I am going to train twice as hard.
Good fight! Do not get comfortable, I will catch up.
Hey, you are the Outsider from the rift! I am Mira. Battle me?
I am going to find the first relic, and you are not beating me to it!
Friendly match, sure. But I am playing to win!
Ha! One point to me. Do not sulk, you will get better.
That was fun! Next time bring your best, I will.
Okay, you earned that one. You keep surprising me.
Ugh, I was so sure! Fine, you are officially my rival.
I will be back stronger. Count on it.
Look who is back! I have been training since our last match.
No hard feelings, but I am not losing to you twice!
Ready? I have a few new tricks to show off.
Yes! Told you I would improve. Better luck next time!
I won this time, but you made me work for it.
Wow. You are getting scary good, you know that?
Fine, fine, you win. But I am right behind you!
That was a real fight. I needed that.
There you are! I knew we would meet again out here.
I have seen things that changed how I fight. Let me show you.
This is not just a game for me anymore. Go all out!
I did not want to win like this, but I am not holding back.
You are close, I can feel it. Keep pushing!
You are ahead of me. I hate it and I love it.
Okay, now I really have something to prove.
Go. I will meet you at the top, just wait.
Things are getting serious, so I am not going easy on you.
Every time we fight, I learn something. Teach me more!
Stay sharp. I did not come this far to fall behind.
I have to keep up with you somehow. Today that is a win.
Do not give up. Come back when you are ready.
That was incredible. You have really earned it.
I am proud to call you my rival, and I mean it.
One last duel is coming. Make it count.
This is it for me, you and I, no tricks and no holding back.
We started as rivals, and I want to see how far we both got.
I trained for this duel every single day. Show me your best!
That is my best. I hope it was worth the wait!
So close! You can beat me, I know you can.
You did it. You are the better trainer, and I am glad it was you.
Best rival anyone could ask for. Thank you, truly.
Go on. I will be cheering from right here.
Last duel, no more warm ups. Everything I have, right now!
We have raced all this way. Let us see who is faster!
Do not hold back, or I will never forgive you!
I won! After all this, I actually won. Wow.
You gave me everything and I am grateful for it.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.spark_neshi_01.o: Well fought. The shrine sees it.
You carry yourself with respect. Go in peace.
Ekayon will hear of this duel.
Ekayon trusts me to hold this ground.
Show me your strength, Outsider. Honestly.
The shrine stands, and so do I.
Come back when your bond runs deeper.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.spark_ophelia_cr: An error in my model. Noted and corrected.
Interesting. You are more than a variable.
Lysandre will hear of this. Coldly, and in detail.
I have calculated this battle. You are the error.
Every raid is a plan. You are a small detail.
Let us be efficient. Two Pokemon, one result.
Exactly as predicted. The raid continues.
Pity. The odds were never in your favor.
How do you keep breaking my plans?!
I will not forgive this. Lysandre will see me prevail.
I recalculated everything. You will not escape twice.
Flare returns in force, and I lead the line.
Last time was a data point. Today is a result.
As the new model predicted. Do not rise again.
Your defeat was always in the numbers.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.spark_pertinax_0: Hmph. Strong, I will give you that.
Winning a duel changes nothing. My mind stays.
Do not mistake my silence for surrender.
You do not belong here, Outsider.
I will not bend. Not for you, not for anyone.
Go back through your rift. I will make you.
As I said. This world has no room for you.
Leave. Before the balance breaks further.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.spark_pip_hartwe: Great battle! You really have the spark for this.
Impressive. You are going to make a fine trainer.
I will remember this fight. Good luck out there!
Welcome, newcomer! Let us see how you handle a real battle.
Do not worry, I will be gentle. Maybe.
Everyone starts somewhere. This is your first step.
Good try! Practice a little more and come back.
I win this round, but you showed promise.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.spark_prof_ansel: You fought with real instinct. I am impressed.
Remember this one. It belongs in a museum.
Ah, a challenger! Let us see what you have dug up.
Old Pokemon taught me patience. Let us begin.
Every battle is a fossil of a lesson.
Fascinating. Study the loss, it is a fine artifact.
Do come back. I would love to see you improve.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.spark_ranger_isa: Good work! You handle wild danger like a true ranger.
I will log this in my report. You helped a lot.
Keep your guard up, there may be more of them.
Stay back! Something strange is moving near the rifts.
These Pokemon are not acting like themselves. I must stop them.
Stand with me, Outsider, and I will see how you battle.
Careful now! The danger is real. Do not rush in.
Get some rest. I will keep watch for you.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.spark_richard_nu: Remarkable. Your results exceeded my predictions.
The numbers do not lie. You are strong.
Well done. The work you do will matter.
Welcome. I have waited a long time to see how far you have come.
Science taught me to test everything. Let us test you.
The field is charged. Show me what you can do.
Interesting data. You will do better with more experience.
A good attempt. Analyze your mistakes and try again.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.spark_sergeant_e: You earned this one. Do not let it go to your head.
Stand straight. I keep order here, and I fight fair.
Eyes front. Show me discipline, not just power.
Ready when you are. No excuses afterward.
Order wins again. Review your mistakes.
Not bad, but strength alone is not enough.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.spark_silas_rook: Grr! Strong. But my loyalty stays unbroken.
This is not the end. Lysandre still watches.
Hmph. Enjoy it while it lasts.
Lysandre gave me one order. Break whoever stands here.
You walked right into it. That was a mistake.
I do not talk. I crush.
Crushed, like all who stand in his way.
Get up if you can. I will wait.
No! I trained for this, and you still stand!
Lysandre... forgive me. I will not fail again.
I have been waiting for this. No holding back now.
Last time I went easy. Not again.
Lysandre's will is my fury. Fall!
Stay down. Do not make me repeat it.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.spark_tavi_01.on: I yield, but my duty does not end here.
Strong, yes. But strength will not heal this world.
Speak to the land with respect, or it will answer.
You walk where you should not, Outsider. Turn back.
The rifts are wounds in our world. I will not let more open.
I do not fight for pride. I fight for the land.
The land stands firm. Leave this place.
You have no right here. Go back where you came from.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.spark_tomas_reye: Whoa, you broke my whole setup!
Back to the workbench for me. Great fight.
I need to rebuild this plan. Thanks for the data.
Hold on, calibrating. Okay, I am ready!
Let me test my machines against your team.
Two Pokemon, one system. Watch the timing.
Ha, the numbers held up! Run it again.
Failure is just data. Take notes, friend.
Overload! You outplayed the whole design.
Incredible. I will study this fight for weeks.
Okay, that was worth every broken part.
Version two is ready. Faster, smarter, louder.
Every gear is tuned. Let us run the test!
I rebuilt everything after our last meeting.
Not even a hiccup. The machines worked flawlessly.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.spark_ulda_01.on: You fought with honor. I will say so.
Pass, then. But the land watches you.
Pertinax will not be pleased. I am not sorry.
This border is not yours to cross.
Pertinax speaks, and I stand ready.
A duel of honor. Prove you are worthy.
You are not ready. Turn back.
The land refuses you. Leave this border.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.spark_wanda_01.o: Well, that was a steep hill! You win fair and square.
I need a long rest after that one, honestly.
Watch your step on the road ahead, it gets rough.
Nice day for a hike, and a battle! Ready, traveler?
I have climbed every ridge around here, so do not underestimate me.
My Pokemon are tough as mountain stone!
Ha! Mountain rock does not crumble that easily.
Keep climbing, friend. You will get there, trust me.
dialogs.steamon_trainer.spark_zuri_nakam: Incredible! You found my weak spot!
Best fight I have had since the last cave-in.
Okay, okay, you win. Treasure goes to you!
Hah, a duel! Almost as fun as a collapsing ruin.
I fear nothing, not traps, not curses, not you!
Let us see what you are made of!
Ha! Another trap you did not see coming.
Do not worry, everyone falls in the first pit.
series.steamon_trainer.steamos_might.des: Join Team Might, the warriors of the ship-temple, and face what comes through the rifts.
series.steamon_trainer.steamos_relic.des: Join Team Relic, the treasure hunters and historians, and face what comes through the rifts.
series.steamon_trainer.steamos_spark.des: Join Team Spark, the engineers and inventors, and face what comes through the rifts.
